narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Management consistently over-promises on O2C recovery timelines and Retail profitability milestones, while delivering on Jio metrics. Of 12 specific guidance points tracked over 4 quarters, 5 were missed, 4 hit, and 3 beaten — a mixed record skewed by the O2C segment underdelivering while digital outperforms.

guided.guidance: Double-digit consolidated revenue growth in FY27

quarters.commentary: Management attributed revenue shortfall to weak global refining cracks. Jio continues to deliver, but Retail margin guidance was ambitious given competitive intensity from Quick Commerce.

guided.guidance: FY26 capex of ₹1.4L Cr across all verticals
GRM recovery to $8-9/bbl range by Q4
Giga factory Phase 1 commissioning by March 2026

delivered.actual: Phase 1 battery cell line operational March 2026

quarters.commentary: Capex overrun wasn't flagged as a concern but O2C persistently underwhelms vs. guidance. New Energy commissioning was a hit — one of the few clean deliveries on timeline guidance.

delivered.actual: 312 new stores in Q3 — on track for H2 target

quarters.commentary: Strong quarter where both consumer-facing businesses outperformed. Jio's tariff hike cycle boosted both ARPU and subscriber growth simultaneously — a rare double-win.

guided.guidance: EBITDA growth of 15%+ YoY in FY26
Net debt free at O2C level by FY26-end

delivered.actual: EBITDA up 11.4% YoY — short of 15%+ guidance
O2C net debt reduced to ₹8,200 Cr — not yet net-debt-free

quarters.commentary: Digital crossed the ₹30K Cr mark, but the two bigger-ticket commitments — 15% EBITDA growth and O2C debt-free status — were behind schedule. A pattern emerges: Jio delivers, O2C disappoints.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Clear pattern: Jio/Digital guidance is reliable, O2C guidance is consistently optimistic, and Retail guidance is hit-or-miss. Management should be discounted ~20% on any O2C-specific forward estimates.

bull_bear.bull: Jio is now India's largest digital platform with 490M subscribers and rising ARPU. Retail is the largest offline retailer. New Energy positions for energy transition. Sum-of-parts valuation gives 40%+ upside if Jio IPO materialises at 20× EV/EBITDA.
bull_bear.bear: O2C (still 45% of EBITDA) faces structural headwinds from global refining overcapacity. Capex of ₹1.5L Cr/year burns free cash flow. New Energy is pre-revenue. No Jio IPO timeline. ROCE at 10.8% is mediocre for the PE multiple.
